scripts.start:local: npm run check:node:local && serverless offline start --stage local
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run check:node:dev && serverless deploy --stage dev
scripts.remove:dev: npm run check:node:dev && serverless remove --stage dev
scripts.print:local: npm run check:node:local && serverless print --stage local
scripts.print:dev: npm run check:node:dev && serverless print --stage dev
scripts.print:prod: npm run check:node:dev && serverless print --stage prod
scripts.create-domain:dev: npm run check:node:dev && serverless create_domain --stage dev
scripts.delete-domain:dev: npm run check:node:dev && serverless delete_domain --stage dev
scripts.check:node:local: node -e "const v=Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]); if(v !== 20){ console.error('Usa Node 20 para local'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.check:node:dev: node -e "const v=Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]); if(v !== 22){ console.error('Usa Node 22 para dev/CI'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.check:node: node -e "const v=Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]); if(![20,22].includes(v)){ console.error('Usa Node 20 o 22'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.logs:cupcake: npm run check:node:dev && serverless logs -f cupcake -t --stage dev
